title: Santosh Kumar Singh v. State through CBI (Priyadarshini Mattoo Murder)
crime_type: Obsessive Stalking / Rape / Premeditated Homicide by Blunt Force & Wire
court_or_authority: Supreme Court of India / High Court of Delhi
source: Supreme Court of India Judgment & Indian Kanoon (doc/1359141)
evidence: Multiple prior police complaints of harassment and stalker intimidation lodged by victim at Vasant Kunj and Maurice Nagar police stations
Broken motorcycle helmet visor glass discovered at crime scene matching suspect helmet
DNA semen sample analysis conducted by Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) establishing conclusive biological match
Severe blunt force skull fractures and ligature marks from an electrical heat-convector wire around victim neck

personality_disorder: Malignant narcissistic stalking, predatory sexual fixation, and aggressive entitlement driven by paternal police influence.
common_traits: Persistent stalking and intimidation across campus environments
Using motorcycle equipment as lethal blunt force weapon
Strangulation using domestic household electrical cords
Exploitation of family law-enforcement connections during initial investigation
summary: Supreme Court landmark ruling on DNA forensic admissibility in sexual assault and homicide prosecutions. Overturned controversial trial court acquittal, confirming that DNA profiling is an infallible scientific indicator connecting the perpetrator to the victim.
